## 0. Load

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)  
library(sf)  


```

```{r}
Seeds<- read_excel("VFT TPC experiment/Raw data/Copy of DIOMUS_Seedbank_july2026.xlsx", sheet = 1, col_names = TRUE)
```

## 1. Make a map showing seed sources

```{r}
## Clean the coordinate columns.

Seeds$Lat <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", Seeds$Lat)) ## Remove anything that's not a number or "." or "-".
Seeds$Long <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", Seeds$Long))


## Extract useful columns and make an interactive map
Seeds_subset <- Seeds %>%
  select(Location, Lat,Long, `Collection date`, Viability) 
## Make sure Longitudes are negative or otherwise they end up in Tibet
Seeds_subset$Long <- ifelse (Seeds_subset$Long < 0, Seeds_subset$Long,
                             -1*Seeds_subset$Long)   
  




```

```{r}
## Add demographic sites to this map

vft_populations <- st_read("VFT TPC experiment/Raw data/Shapefiles/VFT_populations_with_HS.shp")
vft_populations <- vft_populations[which(!is.na(vft_populations$Population)),]

vft_populations$Long <- st_coordinates(vft_populations)[,1]
vft_populations$Lat <- st_coordinates(vft_populations)[,2]


Seeds_map <- leaflet(data = Seeds_subset) %>%
  addTiles() %>%  # Adds standard OpenStreetMap background
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~Long,
    lat = ~Lat,
    radius = 2,
    label = ~Location,
    popup = ~Location,# Also show names on click,
    labelOptions= labelOptions(noHide = TRUE)) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data=vft_populations, lng=~Long, lat=~Lat, 
                    label = ~Population, color="green") %>%
  addScaleBar()

```
